description: This file defines a Python language generator class for code generation in the Playwright testing framework, including methods for generating test scripts, handling actions, and formatting code snippets.

classes.name: PythonLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates Python code for Playwright actions, supporting async and PyTest modes, with methods for generating actions, headers, and footers.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates Python code for a given Playwright action within a specific context.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates the code string for specific actions like click, fill, navigate, etc.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Generates the initial code header for the test script, including imports and setup.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Generates the closing code for the test script, including closing context and browser.
